name: Aditya Dwi Saputra Nugraha
bio: I'm a Software Developer based in Bekasi, Indonesia, specializing in modern web applications, real-time communication systems, and enterprise software development.

My experience spans frontend engineering, backend integration, client-side data management, and application architecture. I enjoy solving complex technical challenges and transforming ideas into reliable, maintainable, and user-friendly digital products.
I'm particularly interested in software architecture, system design, interactive web experiences, and building technology that solves real-world problems.

process.title: UNDERSTAND()
